item.title: Version 1.1.0
item.description:
Real history, and ranges to read it in

  • The chart starts where your business did — MRRDock now backfills the daily MRR series from the provider itself, instead of only showing the days since you added the source. RevenueCat today; other providers keep the local readings until their turn.
  • Ranges — 24H, 7D, 1Y, or two dates on a calendar.
  • A truthful line — time on the x-axis, days summed only when every source reports them, and no leading zeros from before you had customers.
